comments.author: DonHopkins
comments.story: That Secret Service SIM farm story is bogus
comments.why: Artist faked a traffic jam with 99 phones.
comments.text: Maybe they were going to use them to hack Google Maps and fake traffic jams! An Artist Used 99 Phones to Fake a Google Maps Traffic Jam: [LINK] Google Maps Hacks by Simon Weckert [VIDEO] >99 smartphones are transported in a handcart to generate virtual traffic jam in Google Maps.Through this activity, it is possible to turn a green street red which has an impact in the physical world by navigating cars on another route to avoid being stuck in traffic. #googlemapshacks

comments.story: One malicious car could trick smart traffic control systems in the US (2018)
comments.why: Fun traffic attack example using a wagon of phones.
comments.text: As far as traffic attack vectors go, this is semi-intersting. I like the wagon of smart phones attack[0]. Seems more fun and easy to do. I'll bet you could get all of Waymo's cars to reroute or force them to funnel into one street. THAT would be a cool show. [0] [VIDEO]

comments.author: mabbo
comments.story: Microsoft AI suggests Ottawa food bank as a “cannot miss” tourist spot
comments.why: 99 phones in a wagon fake a traffic jam.
comments.text: [VIDEO] He put 99 smart phones in a wagon with all of them running Google maps in drive mode. Google interpreted this as a traffic jam, and made other cars avoid the area.
